provider: Purdue Geospatial Data Science Lab / Indiana Digital Forestry
measurement_method: Transform FID 647 WGS84 polygon to EPSG:2968 and sample raster pixel centers strictly inside. Tile origin 2,995,000 ftUS, 1,890,000 ftUS, pixel size 5 ft.
uncertainty: Normalized surface height is not a surveyed wall/eave/ridge height; canopy and edge mixed pixels remain possible.
